title: EXCEPT — Products Never Ordered
description: Find products that have never been ordered using EXCEPT.

data.text: Write a query to find all ProductIDs that are in Products but never appear in OrderDetails.

data.title: SQL Solution
data.code:
SELECT ProductID FROM Products
EXCEPT
SELECT ProductID FROM OrderDetails
ORDER BY ProductID;

data.title: Explanation
data.text: EXCEPT returns rows in the first query that are NOT in the second. Like INTERSECT, duplicates are removed and results are sorted. EXCEPT is often clearer than NOT IN or LEFT JOIN + IS NULL for anti-join scenarios.
